purpose: Run a hosted validator whose PrepareProposal agrees with its ProcessProposal (the ABCI++ coherence requirement). Since b8cff9c1, which 5542b221 contains, ProcessProposal replays every regular transaction through the full ante handler at the proposal's height and time and refuses the whole block if one fails, while PrepareProposal offered mempool candidates without that replay.

source.production_change: app/abci.go only: PrepareProposal replays each candidate it will take with BaseApp.PrepareProposalVerifyTx, in proposal order, against the disposable proposal state, and offers only those that pass.

deployment_prerequisites: The hosted runtime refuses a changed binary by design: run-upgrade checks the staged target against the applied upgrade packet, the first applied observation pins the target's source and binary, and the gateway refuses to rewrite a published descriptor. A reviewed runtime and gateway change must add an explicit, externally pinned binary-patch path before this binary can run; no guard is to be bypassed.
The development site asserts that the runtime binary equals the Linux participant binary, so its publication model needs a reviewed change for a validator-only patch, or a new participant release.
The source commit must be fetchable from the public repository before the descriptor names it.
Deployment, any upload and the publication update each need the owner's word.
